_help: One entry per employer. 'system' says which careers software they use. Set enabled to false to skip an employer. Entries marked verify:true have settings that need checking on the first run - see the run report. Entries with system 'clinch', 'phenom' or 'custom' need a new connector before they can be enabled. Set "remove": true to take an employer (and all its roles) off the board at the next run, for example after a removal request.
